title: CustomerRequirements
description:
Bridge-style requirements view of a customer. All four buckets are
always present (may be empty). `requirements_due` is a quick coarse
summary — partners can use it to decide whether any action is needed
before drilling into the detail buckets.

issues.description: Terminal blockers the customer cannot self-remediate.

missing.description: Requirements the customer can still satisfy (resubmittable).

pending.description: Requirements the customer has submitted, awaiting review.

requirements_due.description:
Sorted, deduplicated set of categories that have at least one
non-complete item. Empty for fully-onboarded customers.

MissingQuestion.description:
A required questionnaire question the customer has left unanswered, resolved
against the Sumsub questionnaire definition.

section_id.description: The questionnaire section the question belongs to, when known.

title.description: Human-readable question text the applicant saw.

MissingQuestion.title: MissingQuestion

RejectReason.description:
A Sumsub rejection reason: the stable code paired with a human-readable
description, so partners can display the reason without maintaining their
own code→text mapping.
RejectReason.title: RejectReason

RequirementCategory.description:
Coarse summary of which areas of the customer's Sumsub KYC/KYB process
still need attention. Used as a quick filter — full detail lives in the
four `complete`/`pending`/`missing`/`issues` buckets.

RequirementCode.description:
Stable, switchable identifier for a single requirement. Partners should
branch on this rather than parsing `description`, which holds the
verbatim text from Sumsub (and is subject to change without notice).

RequirementItem.description:
A single requirement entry returned in one of the four buckets on
`ApiCustomerRequirements`.

description.description:
Human-readable reason from Sumsub — the moderation comment and the
applicant-facing client comment combined (moderator note first,
deduped), a list of the specific unanswered questionnaire questions, or
a synthesized note for the identification-level codes. May be `null`.
*IMPORTANT*: This field is subject to change without notice — switch
on `code` (and `reject_labels`), not on this string.

identification_id.description: The identification that produced this item, when applicable.

missing_questions.description:
Required questionnaire questions the customer left unanswered, resolved
against the Sumsub questionnaire definition (so `title` is the question
text the applicant saw). Only populated for the questionnaire codes
(`kyc_questionnaire` / `kyb_questionnaire`); empty otherwise.

reject_labels.description:
Coded Sumsub rejection reasons for this step (e.g. `SCREENSHOTS`,
`UNSATISFACTORY_PHOTOS`) — the pills shown in the Sumsub dashboard.
Empty when the step carries no labels.

reject_reasons.description:
Same reasons as `reject_labels`, each paired with a human-readable
description. Prefer this for display; `reject_labels` stays the stable
set of codes to switch on. Empty when the step carries no labels.

retryable.description:
`true` if the customer can resubmit to clear this item
(Sumsub `reject_type == Retry`). `false` for terminal/Final
rejections. `null` for `complete`/`pending` items, where retry
semantics don't apply.

RequirementItem.title: RequirementItem
